meta.name: ahrefs
meta.description: Query Ahrefs SEO data — backlinks, domain rating, organic keywords, competitors, and SERP analysis. Use for competitive analysis, link building, and keyword research.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 查询外链、关键词与竞品数据,洞察搜索引擎表现
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想了解网站或竞争对手的搜索排名状况。
copy.tagline_en: Fetch backlink, keyword, and competitor data to gauge search performance
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to analyze website rankings or outrank competitors.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能查询 Ahrefs 的 SEO 数据,包括网站的反向链接、域名评分、自然关键词、竞争对手和搜索结果页面(SERP)分析,并返回对应指标。
howto.when: 当用户提出竞争对手分析、外链建设、关键词研究等 SEO 相关需求时,Claude 会调用 Ahrefs 数据来回答。

say.text: 查 example.com 的域名评分和自然关键词
say.note: 返回 DR、关键词和流量数据

say.text: 分析 example.com 的有机竞争对手有哪些
say.note: 列出竞争域名及共同关键词

say.text: 帮我查关键词 'best running shoes' 的难度
say.note: 返回搜索量、难度、CPC 等

howto.what_en: Claude can query Ahrefs SEO data: backlinks, domain rating, organic keywords, competitors, and SERP analysis, returning the relevant metrics.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks for competitive analysis, link building, keyword research, or other similar SEO tasks.

say_en.text: Check example.com's domain rating and organic keywords.
say_en.note: Returns DR, keywords, and traffic data.
Lists competing domains with shared keywords.
